faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker / Helper / Mini Anganwadi Worker posts is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all the posts announced by WCD Odisha.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th grade from a recognized board to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available in this WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available for the posts of Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper, and Mini Anganwadi Worker.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 4500/- to Rs. 7500/- per month, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for WCD Odisha jobs?
faq.answer: All eligible candidates are required to apply online through the official recruitment portal of WCD Odisha.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for WCD Odisha Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by document verification, and finally, a merit list will be prepared.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha (WCD Odisha).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
